verdict.rationale: Community users describe LaunchDarkly's Relay Proxy, a small Go application the vendor ships for self-hosting, as open source, so one product component's source is readable. Nothing in the pack shows the core LaunchDarkly platform is open, and the open status comes only from community comments. Missing for 10: open-source core service, a first-party statement naming the license, and evidence on SDK or CLI source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly has an open source 'Relay' you can run in your own environment for extra resiliency.
LD's open-source Relay lets you run proxies closer to your services.
The LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy is a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure.
